name: crow
about: Chain ragdoll body for the crow (original-crow, carrion and ragged variants). Armagedom's crow GLB is the rat rig with the same 24 bones and no wing bones, so this is the rat king's 13-capsule layout, thinner and much lighter: hips (root, pelvis to chest), chest, head (neck to bite_tip), tail_a, tail_b, and 4 legs x (upper, lower). The wings are skinned to the chest and spine bones and follow the chest body; bones without a body follow their parent bone. Every number is here; src/chain.mjs holds none.
placeholder_note: radii, masses, joint limits and motor scales are PLACEHOLDERS to tune on Dom's phone and the clips; only the bone positions are measured.
scale_source: Armagedom Web/src/data/creatureDefinitions.json original-crow scale.model 4 (the plain rat is 3). The actor wrapper's character 1.265 / visual 1.3225 multipliers are NOT applied here: the game applies them to the sim root. ASSUMPTION: original-crow.glb bones are at the same units as the rat's.
mass_assumption: placeholder: a real carrion crow is about 0.5 kg; at x4 the body is 1.2 m (longer than a goose), by volume 32 kg, but Dom asked for a small light bird, so 6 kg total so it drops fast and lies light. Tune.
inertia_source: data/ragdoll-role-table.json motor.inertia_multiplier (M1 finding), same value as the humanoid rows
hinge_flex_z_source: own: same rig and same elbow-shaped leg geometry as the rat king (joint at the shin bone sits behind hip and paw), so the lower leg folds forward (+z) for hind and front alike.

segments.source: placeholder: root, pelvis to chest (spine rides on it)
placeholder: chest to neck plus 0.015 model units (wings follow this body)
placeholder: neck to bite_tip (neck, head, jaw, bite_tip as one capsule)
placeholder: tail_1 to tail_3 (tail_2 rides on it)
placeholder: tail_3 to tail_4 plus 0.03 model units past the last bone
placeholder: shin and paw as one capsule; hinge range is flexion from a straight leg, the rest pose is bent about 90 degrees
